annotations.text:
Stat bar uses YOUR real figures from src/data/infrastructure.js, not the reference's.

The reference showed 5 Plants / 2.5L+ MT / 150+ Machines / 100% Tested / 1000+ People. Your recorded storage is 61,500 MT — the reference's 2.5L+ MT would have been ~40x your actual figure, and plant/machine counts aren't tracked anywhere in the repo.

Shown instead: 210,240 MTPA capacity, 61,500 MT storage, 21 silos, 10 processing stages, 1000+ across the value chain.

All six card photos and the hero are your own files from /public/assets — silos, plant, factory, quality inspection, transportation, paddy selection. Downsampled for the canvas only; the real page would use the originals.

No stock photography and no invented imagery.
